items.name: Tenshi-Do Cowabunga School Holiday Program
items.suburb: Ravenhall, near Caroline Springs (Unit 5/94 Eucumbene Drive)
items.description: Holiday program at Tenshi-Do Martial Arts, 8.30am–5.30pm, open to students, siblings and friends: karate and gymnastics drills and games, Wii sports, movies and colouring. Book 6 days and the final 2 are free (same child). Bring lunch, snacks, a named water bottle and a change of clothes. Book by messaging the form to 0402 203 567 or tenshidoma@gmail.com.

items.description: Local park with play equipment, seating and a shared path for walking or riding.

items.name: Allenby Road Reserve
items.description: Neighbourhood park with play equipment, picnic areas with BBQs, shelter and a drinking fountain.

items.description: Dinosaur-themed play equipment, BBQs, picnic tables and shelter.

items.name: Aintree Town Centre Reserve
items.description: Town-centre park with seating, shelter and a water play feature (council says it is switched off over winter and resumes in warmer weather).
facts: A park within the Aintree town centre shopping precinct with seating, shelter, a drinking fountain and a water play feature.
Council says the water play was turned off for winter and will resume later in 2026 as the warm weather returns.

items.name: Anghor Drive Reserve
items.description: Play equipment, picnic areas, shared path, bike station, shelter and a drinking fountain.

items.name: Angul Parade Reserve
items.description: Play equipment plus basketball facilities, BBQ, picnic areas and shelter.

items.name: Acacia Crescent Reserve
items.description: Local park with play equipment, seating and a shared path.

items.name: Aintree Recreation Reserve
items.description: Multi-use reserve with tennis, netball and basketball courts, cricket nets, sports fields, a skate park and toilets.
facts: Frontier Park playground, with water play, and Frontier Park Pavilion sit within Aintree Recreation Reserve.

Council is repairing the Frontier Park playground tower roof in two stages so the playground is ready for the summer holidays: the water play park stays open in stage one (up to four weeks) and closes in stage two (up to two weeks).

items.name: Isabella Williams Memorial Reserve
items.description: Listed by Brimbank Council among parks around Deer Park.
facts: Brimbank lists it as a flagship park.
The centrepiece is a large 'volcano' with tall climbing walls, nets and three long slides, including a yellow covered twisted slide.
A path network runs through the adjoining grasslands to Kororoit Creek Reserve.

items.description: Listed by Brimbank Council among parks around Sunshine.

items.description: Listed by Brimbank Council among parks around Sunshine.

items.description: Parks Victoria park with free gas BBQs, shelters and picnic tables, plus a café.

items.name: Organ Pipes National Park
items.description: National park managed by Parks Victoria.

items.name: Werribee Gorge State Park
items.description: Walks through a river-washed gorge and along rocky ridges. Better for older kids.

items.name: Melton Waves Leisure Centre
items.address: Melton Waves Leisure Centre, 206 Coburns Road, Melton VIC 3337
items.ages: Babies, kids and adults (BlueFit program-wide: infants from 4 months to 3 years, then preschool 3+ through to squad)
items.hours: Centre: Mon–Fri 5am–9pm; Sat, Sun and public holidays 8am–6pm. Gym open 24/7.
items.price: $22.00 per lesson ($44.00 per fortnight) for learn-to-swim
items.description: Wave pool, warm water pool, 25 m indoor pool, seasonal 50 m outdoor pool and swim school.
facts: BlueFit Swimming runs the learn-to-swim program at Melton Waves. The Melton Waves learn-to-swim page lists $22.00 per lesson ($44.00 per fortnight).

items.name: Sunshine Leisure Centre swimming lessons
items.description: Brimbank Leisure Centres learn-to-swim program.

items.name: Brimbank Aquatic and Wellness Centre swim school
items.hours: Aquatic facilities Mon–Fri 6am–8.30pm, weekends 8am–6.30pm; public holidays typically 9am–5pm (pools close 4.30pm)
items.description: Swim school with a waitlist.
facts: The swim school is at capacity. New families join an online waitlist, which the centre says runs about 2–3 months depending on level.
Sunshine Leisure Centre has classes available for all levels; enquire with swimschool@brimbank.vic.gov.au.
The centre also has waterslides (Mon–Fri 4–7pm, weekends 10am–5pm) and a splash park (Mon–Fri 9am–7pm, weekends 8am–6pm).

items.name: AquaPulse (WynSwim lessons)
items.ages: Little Wonders 6–36 months (parent or carer in the water); preschool 3–5 years; school-age and adult programs from 5 years
items.hours: General hours: Mon–Thu 5.30am–9pm, Fri 5.30am–8pm, Sat 7am–6pm, Sun and public holidays 8am–6pm (subject to change).
items.price: Enrolment fee $32.20; $27.80 per lesson ($55.60 per direct debit). Prices applicable from 1 July 2026. No minimum term.
items.description: Wyndham aquatic centre at 80–82 Derrimut Rd, run by WynActive.
facts: Wyndham's aquatic and fitness centre, run by WynActive, with pools, waterslides, spa, sauna and steam.
Activities include lap swimming, learn-to-swim lessons and aqua aerobics, plus a gym and group fitness classes.
A party room is available for hire.
WynActive notes that opening hours are subject to change.

items.name: Preschool Storytime, Caroline Springs Library
items.description: Stories, songs and rhymes for ages 3–6. Check the events calendar for session times.

items.name: Toddler Time, Melton City Libraries
items.description: Sessions for ages 1–3 at Melton library branches.

items.name: Brimbank Libraries programs for children
items.description: Regular, term-based children's programs at Brimbank library branches.

items.name: Brimbank Libraries school holiday program
items.description: Library holiday program. All activities are free (summer edition included NGV Kids on Tour and the BIG Summer Read).

items.name: Make Your Own 3D Pizza with 3D Printing (ages 6–10)
items.description: Saturday 17 October 2026, 11am–12pm. Bookings required.

items.name: Melton City Council Vacation Care
items.address: Bridge Road Children's & Community Centre, 260–266 Bridge Road, Strathtulloh 3338
items.price: $94.50 per day flat rate, plus excursion/incursion charges
items.description: Holiday care for primary-aged kids, 7am–6pm weekdays. Summer 2026–27 is a flat $94.50 per day plus excursions; Child Care Subsidy may apply.
facts: Runs Monday to Friday, 7am–6pm, during the Victorian school holidays; book any single day or the whole program.
Child Care Subsidy is deducted from the invoice for eligible families. It isn't an NDIS service.
Council said summer 2026–27 dates, activities and booking details will be released soon.

Places are allocated under council's access guidelines for families who live, work or send children to primary school in the City of Melton; families from outside may also apply, and late bookings may attract a fee.

items.name: Melton community centre holiday workshops
items.suburb: Taylors Hill, Caroline Springs, Fraser Rise, Plumpton and more
items.description: Council-run workshops each holiday break (science, art, cooking, puppets). April 2026 sessions were $3–$10 and many sold out.

items.name: Get Activated multi-sport morning (past event, summer repeat TBC)
items.description: Ran on 2 July 2026 in the winter break for ages 1–12. Not yet confirmed for summer, so check the source.

items.name: Melton Youth Holiday Activities
items.description: Excursions and local activities for ages 12–25, booked online before each break.
facts: Holiday activity details are released before each school break, and all bookings are made online at the time council specifies; call 9747 5373 to join the mailing list.
During term, Launch Pad is a drop-in for 12–17s on Fridays 3.30–5.30pm at Melton Youth Centre, 193 Barries Road.
iPlay offers sport and games for 12–25s: Mondays 3.30–6pm at Cobblebank Stadium and Thursdays 3.30–6pm at Caroline Springs Leisure Centre.
Registration is essential for term programs.

items.name: Code Camp
items.description: Holiday and after-school coding camps. Check the site for western suburbs venues.

items.name: TeamKids
items.description: Out-of-school-hours and holiday care at primary school sites.

items.name: Werribee Open Range Zoo
items.description: Zoos Victoria wildlife safari in Melbourne's west.

items.name: Scienceworks
items.description: Science museum. The 'Colour' exhibition (ages 5–14) is reported to run until 26 Jan 2027.

items.name: SuperPark Highpoint
items.description: Indoor activity park at Highpoint.

items.name: Amphitheatre Street Reserve
items.description: Neighbourhood park with sheltered seating, picnic facilities, a shared path and a drinking fountain.

items.name: Arbour Boulevard Central Reserve
items.description: Neighbourhood park with play equipment, shared path and seating; council says an upgrade (new play equipment, sheltered picnic spaces, outdoor gym) is under way in 2026.

items.name: Bridge Road Recreation Reserve and Regional Play Space
items.description: Regional play space beside an athletics track and hockey pitch, with play equipment, BBQ, picnic areas, shelter and shared paths.
facts: The reserve combines the Bridge Road Regional Play Space with the Bridge Road Athletics Precinct (athletics track, hockey pitch and pavilion).
Home ground for Melton Hockey Club, Caroline Springs Hockey Club, Melton City Little Athletics and Melton City Runners.
Next to Bridge Road Children's and Community Centre; facilities include BBQ, picnic areas, shelter, drinking fountain, shared paths and a car park.

items.name: Hannah Watts Park
items.description: Redeveloped 2019: in-ground trampolines, tower with giant slide, flying fox, accessible swings and whirly go-round, natural play, accessible BBQs and toilets.
facts: Play features include in-ground trampolines, a tower with a giant slide and climbing, a flying fox, and parent-and-child, nest and all-abilities swings.
The whirly go-round has space and access for a wheelchair, and accessible play panels at the base of the tower include a shop front and musical play.
There's a dry creek bed, stepping stones, log steppers and balance logs, plus sensory play and natural hideouts.
Facilities: picnic shelters with wheelchair-accessible BBQs, an accessible toilet block, drinking fountain, car park and shared path.

items.name: Lake Caroline Waterfront
items.description: 1.9 km path around the lake, play equipment at Boathouse Reserve and Lake Caroline Reserve, BBQ, picnic facilities and drinking fountain.
facts: A path runs the whole 1.9 km perimeter of the lake: good for walking, bike riding or birdwatching.
Three areas around the lake: exercise equipment at Lake Caroline Waterfront, play and exercise equipment at Boathouse Reserve, and play equipment at Lake Caroline Reserve.
Waterfront facilities: BBQ, picnic seating and tables, drinking fountain, bins, car park and dog-bag dispenser.

items.name: Melton Swim School (at Genesis Fitness Melton)
items.address: Located at Genesis Fitness Melton, 15-21 Coburns Road, Melton South VIC 3338; ph 03 9747 4000
items.ages: Children of all ages, plus adults
items.description: Swim and Survive (Royal Life Saving) lessons for children of all ages and adults, located at Genesis Fitness Melton, 15-21 Coburns Road, Melton South; book by phone on 03 9747 4000.
facts: The school's contact page lists the venue as Genesis Fitness Melton at 15-21 Coburns Road, Melton South. A lesson price was not published on the pages checked.

items.name: JUMP! Swim Schools Truganina
items.ages: From 6 months through to stroke development (parent-and-child classes listed for babies 6 months to 4 years)
items.description: Boutique heated indoor learn-to-swim centre on Infinity Drive, Truganina, now open.
facts: JUMP!'s Truganina page lists this centre as open, at $23.50 per lesson.
Parent-and-child classes are listed for babies aged 6 months to 4 years, then independent swimmers and stroke development.

items.name: Baby Bounce, Melton City Libraries
items.ages: 0–12 months, with a parent or carer
items.hours: Caroline Springs Library & Learning Hub: Tue 10–10.30am, Wed 11.30am–12pm. Melton Library & Learning Hub: Tue and Wed 11.30am–12pm.
items.description: Stories and songs for babies 0–12 months. Caroline Springs Library: Tue 10–10.30am and Wed 11.30am–12pm; Melton Library: Tue and Wed 11.30am–12pm. School terms, no booking.
facts: Stories and songs that introduce babies to the sounds and rhythm of language.
Runs every week during school terms; bookings are not required.
Regular library programs don't run on public holidays or during school holidays.
Attending earns Read, Sing, Chat points.
For older children the same libraries run Toddler Time (1–3 years) and Preschool Storytime (3–5 years).

items.name: After Schooligans, Melton City Libraries
items.description: After-school crafts, games, reading and STEM for ages 5–12, Tuesdays 3.45–4.30pm at Melton and Caroline Springs libraries during school terms. No booking.

items.name: Family Tales, Melton City Libraries
items.description: Saturday stories, songs and rhymes for families with children 0–8, one Saturday a month 11–11.30am at both library hubs.

items.name: Burnside Busy Kids Playgroup
items.description: Community playgroup for families with children 0–5 at Burnside Children's & Community Centre, 23 Lexington Drive. Mondays 10.30am–12pm.
facts: Parent-run community playgroup: all families with children aged 0–5 are welcome.
Burnside Children's & Community Centre, 23 Lexington Drive, Burnside.
Contact by email: burnsidebusykids@gmail.com.

items.description: Playgroup at 5 Millport Drive, Tuesdays 10am–12pm during school terms.

items.description: Indoor and outdoor playgroup at 19 Pear Parade, Fraser Rise. Tuesdays 12.30–2pm.

items.description: Playgroup for children 0–5 at 11 Navigation Drive with free entry, tea/coffee and arts and crafts. Thursdays 10–11.30am.

items.name: Botanica Springs Playgroup
items.description: Community playgroup at Botanica Springs Children's & Community Centre, 249 Clarkes Road. Thursdays 9.30–11.30am, school term.

items.name: Melton West Primary School Playgroup
items.description: Playgroup at Melton West Primary, 2–16 Rathdowne Circuit. Tuesdays 8.50–11am and Wednesdays 8.50am–12pm.

items.name: Arnolds Creek Grandparents Playgroup
items.description: Playgroup for grandparents and grandkids at Arnolds Creek Children's and Community Centre, Claret Ash Blvd. Fridays 9.30–11am.

items.name: Gather and Grow Playgroup
items.hours: Tuesdays 10–11.30am, all year including school holidays
items.description: Free play-based playgroup hosted by Aspire Early Education at 52 Dorchester Street, with morning tea provided. Tuesdays 10–11.30am, all year including school holidays.
facts: Play-based sessions include sensory play, arts and crafts, music and movement, storytelling and hands-on learning.
Hosted by Aspire Early Education and Kindergarten; morning tea is provided, so there's no need to bring food.

items.name: Weir Views Community Activation Playgroup
items.description: Free playgroup at Weir Views Children's & Community Centre, 23 Pegasus Road. Tuesdays 12.30–2pm during Term 4 2026; bookings required.

items.name: PlayConnect Playgroup
items.description: Free supported playgroup for children 0–5 with autism, developmental delays or behavioural concerns, at West Melton Children's and Community Centre. Tuesdays 10am–12pm, school term.

items.name: Rhyme Time, Truganina Library Lounge
items.description: Wyndham City Libraries stories, songs and rhymes for ages 1–5 at Truganina Community Centre, 1 Everton Road. Tuesdays and Wednesdays 10.30–11am.

items.name: Baby Time, Truganina Library Lounge
items.description: Songs, rhymes and finger plays for babies 12 months and under. Wednesdays 2pm and Thursdays 10.30am (Term 2 2026 timetable).

items.name: Multicultural Playgroup, Truganina Community Centre
items.hours: Mondays 10am–12pm; listed dates 16, 23 and 30 Nov, 7 and 14 Dec 2026
items.description: Free VICSEG New Futures playgroup for migrant and refugee families at 1 Everton Road. Mondays 10am–12pm.
facts: Run by VICSEG New Futures for migrant and refugee families in Wyndham.
Children learn through play, practise sharing and making friends, and get ready for 4-year-old kindergarten and primary school.
Parents can get information on women's health, parenting, healthy eating, raising children in Australia and local services.

items.name: FLIP Gymnastics Holiday Program (Truganina)
items.description: Gymnastics skills, games, craft and free play for school-aged kids, 9.30am–2pm; Truganina sessions run on Mondays of each break. Bring lunch.

items.name: Wyndham Active Holidays
items.suburb: Truganina, Point Cook, Werribee and more
items.description: Free council-run active sessions each school holiday with community providers; timetable published two weeks before each break.

items.name: Hillside Recreation Reserve
items.description: Large modern play space (71–79 Royal Crescent) with natural play, slides, swings, climbing, sand play and a wheelchair-accessible smooth glider, plus BBQ shelter, skate park, basketball court and exercise equipment.

items.name: Broughton Avenue Reserve
items.description: Play equipment including a rock climbing wall, slide and sandpit, water play for warmer days, BBQ and a walking/cycling path.

items.name: Kurunjang Recreation Reserve
items.description: Centenary Avenue sports reserve with a playground, tennis courts, cricket nets, shelter, toilets and drinking fountain.
facts: Council is extending the soccer pavilion; works were expected to start mid-September 2026 and finish by April 2027.
Used by Falcon Cricket Club, Kurunjang Auskick, Satelite City United Soccer Club, Taylors Hill Cricket Club and Kurunjang Tennis Club.
Facilities include a multi-use oval, cricket nets, tennis and basketball courts, a playground, toilets, drinking fountain and car park.

items.name: Frontier Park (Aintree Recreation Reserve)
items.description: Play equipment with water play, basketball, BBQ, picnic shelter and public toilets at 2 Fields Street.
facts: Council is repairing and securing the playground tower roof, with some areas fenced off while scaffolding is up.
The work runs in two stages so the playground is ready for the summer holidays: water play stays open during stage one (up to four weeks) and closes during stage two (up to two weeks).
Facilities include basketball, BBQ, picnic shelter, seating, toilets, bins and a car park, with open lawn for family gatherings.

items.name: Mushu Street Reserve
items.description: Neighbourhood park at 72 Mushu Street with play equipment, seating, tables and shelter.

items.name: Barwon Street Reserve
items.description: Upgraded playspace (opened July 2025) at 8 Hepburn Court with swings, sandpit with water play, nature play, inclusive play, fitness equipment and a kickabout space.

items.name: Mainview Boulevard Reserve
items.description: Wyndham reserve at 49 Mainview Boulevard with a playground, BBQs, public toilet, outdoor exercise equipment and dog park beside two ovals.
facts: Wyndham lists the reserve's address as 49 Mainview Boulevard, Truganina.
The reserve has bookable indoor and outdoor spaces for sport, fitness classes, community meetings and educational classes, accessible to all ages and abilities.
Long-term tenant clubs, including Truganina Thunder Football Club, have ongoing allocations, so availability can be limited in evenings and on weekends.

items.name: Alcock Road Reserve
items.description: Wyndham sports reserve at 73 Alcock Road with a playground, BBQ facilities and public toilet, plus soccer pitches, cricket ovals and tennis courts.
facts: Wyndham lists the address as 73 Alcock Road, Truganina.
Bookable indoor and outdoor spaces for sport, fitness classes, community meetings and educational classes, accessible to all ages and abilities.
Long-term tenant sports clubs have ongoing allocations, so availability may be limited in evenings and on weekends.

items.name: BlueFit Swimming Truganina
items.description: Learn-to-swim at 90 Elmhurst Road with small classes, make-up lessons and multi-child discounts.
facts: BlueFit's program runs from Infants (4 months to 3 years) and Preschool (3+ years) through School Aged, Adolescent stroke development, Adults and Squads.
Free Splashtime infant classes are offered for babies up to 4 months old.
Small class sizes, multi-child and multi-lesson discounts, and make-up lessons rescheduled through the online portal.
Payments are by debit, quoted as $46.00 per fortnight.

items.name: YMCA Taylors Hill School Holiday Program
items.description: Holiday care for Prep–Grade 6 at Taylors Hill Primary, 12 Park Lane: themed days, incursions and excursions, 6.30am–6.30pm. CCS eligible; summer schedule posted about four weeks before the break.

items.name: Melton City Libraries school holiday program
items.description: Free library holiday activities each break (painting, building, puzzles, chess tournaments, STEM). Bookings required; under-12s need adult supervision.

items.name: Melton Music holiday workshops
items.description: Music theory and songwriting workshops run during school holidays.

items.name: Bullion Park
items.description: Cross Lane community park with play equipment, basketball, BBQs, shelter, picnic area, drinking fountain and shared paths.

items.name: Mawson Gardens
items.description: 46 Wright Circuit park with play equipment, BBQ and picnic facilities, shelter, seating, drinking fountain and car park.

items.name: Cypress Views Village Park
items.description: 20 The Avenue. Play space upgraded in 2026 with a new multiplay unit, triple bay swings, rocker and spinner; BBQ, shelter, basketball and drinking fountain.

items.name: St Georges Avenue Reserve
items.description: 24 St Georges Avenue. 2026 upgrade added a multiplay unit with slides, basket climber and basket swings; also monkey bars, a flying fox, BBQ and basketball.

items.name: Taylors Hill Central Park
items.description: 2A The Walk. Playground mostly under shade sails, with BBQs, picnic tables and a drinking fountain. Council upgrade (including water play) was due to start mid-2026.
facts: Council's upgrade adds accessible play equipment, a sheltered picnic area with BBQs, better paths, a kick-around space and water play.
Council's May 2026 update said the design was complete and works were expected to start by early June 2026.

items.name: Parkwood Green Reserve
items.description: 88-94 Catherine Drive. Playground, BBQ area, basketball and tennis courts, exercise equipment and a pavilion.

items.name: Warringah Reserve
items.description: Glenbruar Drive. Play space upgraded in 2026 with a multiplay unit, carousel, basket swings, monkey bars and frame climber.

items.name: Arnolds Creek Recreation Reserve
items.description: 37 Claret Ash Boulevard. Natural play space with dry creek bed and sensory garden, play tower with rope climbing and slides, flying fox, accessible spinner, BBQ and toilets.
facts: Natural play space (built 2019) with a dry creek bed, grassland sensory garden, play tower with rope climbing and slides, flying fox and an accessible spinner.
Sports fields, basketball and netball facilities, cricket nets, and tennis courts (upgrades completed in 2026).
Picnic shelter, BBQ and tables beside the play equipment, with plenty of trees for shade; toilets, parking and lighting.
Home to Melton Centrals Football Netball Club (senior and junior), St Anthony's Cricket Club and ITennis Coaching Academy.
Council is running biodiversity assessments to inform future improvements.

items.name: Norm Raven Reserve
items.description: 28-38 Glitter Road. Playground closed for an upgrade; council expects completion in November 2026. Also BBQ, picnic tables and a basketball half court.
facts: Playground upgrade under way: new play equipment, footpaths, garden beds and trees. The playground is closed until the expected completion in November 2026; the Pirate Ship play unit was delayed.
BBQ, picnic benches, seats and tables, a drinking fountain, a basketball half court and spacious lawns.
Car park, shelter and pathway on site.

items.name: Rhyme Time, Point Cook Library
items.description: Free 30-minute Wyndham City Libraries session of stories, songs and rhymes at Point Cook Library, 1-21 Cheetham Street, for children aged 1-5 years. No bookings required.

items.name: Story Time, Point Cook Library
items.description: Free 45-minute stories, rhymes and craft session at Point Cook Library, aimed at children 3+ (younger children welcome if they sit with a parent or carer), including monthly bilingual sessions.

items.name: Stockland Point Cook playgroup (Wyndham City)
items.description: Free council shopping-centre playgroup at Stockland Point Cook on Thursdays 10am-11.30am, outside Target in the Target Quadrant, for parents and carers with children up to 5. No bookings required.
